name: Snapdown
instructions: Jump slightly and snap into a tight hollow position — ribs down, legs together, toes pointed.
Land in a controlled quarter squat with arms down, absorbing quietly through the legs.
Reset fully before each rep; quality over speed.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: An intermediate just your bodyweight core exercise for the abs. Snapdown builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
